content_sections.heading: BIRAC Secretarial Intern Job Description
content_sections.text: Day-to-day secretarial support to the Managing Director’s Office. Answer and direct phone calls in a courteous and professional manner. Organize and maintain office files, records, and documents. Assist with data entry, document preparation, and other clerical tasks. Screen documents, book meeting rooms, set up conference calls and take messages. Assist in managing the Managing Director’s daily and weekly schedules, meetings. Coordinate office administration requirements, including stationery, meeting arrangements, travel-related documentation etc. Perform miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.

content_sections.text: Governed by the policy of Young Professional in BIRAC. Initial appointment will be for a period of Six months which may be extended subject to satisfactory performance
